scripts.prebuild: pnpm run codegen && pnpm run spec:check
scripts.build:dry-run: pnpm run codegen && pnpm run spec:check && pnpm run network:validate:fixture && graph build --network robinhood --network-file tests/fixtures/networks.resolved.json --output-dir build-dry-run
scripts.build:production: pnpm run network:validate && pnpm run codegen && pnpm run spec:check && graph build --network robinhood
scripts.prelint: pnpm run codegen && pnpm run spec:check
scripts.pretest: pnpm run codegen && pnpm run spec:check
scripts.pretypecheck: pnpm run codegen && pnpm run spec:check
